assembly_inspection.limits: Apple clang arm64 assembly from matching Release flags; not an assembly claim about GCC/Linux or Windows.

selection.next_repair: Make __ada_finalize_to empty-chain entry small: check owner/checkpoint before TLS and isolate nonempty finalization from the heavy frame.
selection.reason: Guarding empty calls reduced the long allocation workload by about 27%; census confirms approximately 17 mostly-empty finalization calls per allocation.
requirements: Preserve pending exception/message/trace restoration, abort deferral and reentrant/failing finalizers.
Verify a small empty-path entry in generated code, not just source reordering.
Measure matching before/after production builds with all 21 cases, including small-registry/LIFO, throughput and scaling controls.
Run full correctness/sanitizer controls and confirm on native CI before claiming a repair.
selection.deferred: Lexical-master omission reduced blocks about 34% and allocation about 11%, but needs ownership/accessibility/activation proof and is not a production optimization.
